paper text.text: If $B_1$ is empty, then $E=\{bd,ce\}$. Condition (2) of Lemma~\ref{r1:missing-a-criterion} makes $H_2+bd$ and $H_2+ce$ nonplanar, so $H_3$ is nonplanar. Lemma~\ref{r1:missing-a-cut} then makes $bd$ or $ce$ a nonedge of $G$, a contradiction. Suppose next that $B_1$ is one bridge. Interchange $b,c$ and $d,e$ simultaneously if necessary so that its attachments are $\{a,b,d\}$, and put $H_4=B_1+ab+ad$. If $E=\varnothing$, condition (2) makes $H_4$ nonplanar. Contracting the interior of $B$ leaves $H_4$ unchanged, so the graph in condition (1) still contains the nonplanar subgraph $H_4$, while condition (2) requires $H_4$ to be planar. Minimality therefore makes the interior of $B$ a single vertex. If $B_1$ is replaced by an allowed minor $B_1'$ with $B_1'+ab+ad$ nonplanar, neither condition (1) nor condition (2) can hold. Thus Corollary~\ref{common:reduced-forms}, with attachments $a,b,d$ and added edges $ab,ad$, gives the $349$ forms in~\supp{E22}. Every resulting graph has a $K_5$ minor, a cut of at most two vertices, or a proper nontoroidal minor.
